s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive skin lesions with systemic involvement
salient_findings: Purpura and ecchymoses with progression over 12 months
Abnormal liver function test results and renal impairment
key_facts: 1-year history of purpura, ecchymoses, anorexia, and weight loss
Medical history of alcohol abuse and cognitive impairment
Purpura and ecchymoses initially periorbital, progressed over 12 months
Elder abuse excluded
Waxy yellow papules and plaques with purpura in multiple body regions
Anemia, abnormal liver function test results, and renal impairment with moderate proteinuria
Normal serum protein electrophoresis (SPEP) and immunofixation urine protein electrophoresis test results
Unremarkable radiological studies
Punch biopsy showed upper dermal amorphous eosinophilic deposits
Congo red staining was positive
Polarizing light microscopy demonstrated pale apple-green birefringence

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive skin lesions with systemic involvement
salient_findings: Purpura and ecchymoses with progression over 12 months
Abnormal liver function test results and renal impairment
key_facts: 1-year history of purpura, ecchymoses, anorexia, and weight loss
Medical history of alcohol abuse and cognitive impairment
Purpura and ecchymoses initially periorbital, progressed over 12 months
Elder abuse excluded
Waxy yellow papules and plaques with purpura in multiple body regions
Anemia, abnormal liver function test results, and renal impairment with moderate proteinuria
Normal serum protein electrophoresis (SPEP) and immunofixation urine protein electrophoresis test results
Unremarkable radiological studies
Punch biopsy showed upper dermal amorphous eosinophilic deposits
Congo red staining was positive
Polarizing light microscopy demonstrated pale apple-green birefringence

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including purpura, ecchymoses, anorexia, weight loss, and waxy yellow papules and plaques, along with the biopsy findings of upper dermal amorphous eosinophilic deposits, positive Congo red staining, and pale apple-green birefringence under polarizing light microscopy, are characteristic of AL amyloidosis.

rejected.label: alcohol abuse
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of alcohol abuse, it does not fully explain the range of symptoms and biopsy findings, particularly the specific amyloid deposits.

rejected.label: purpura
rejected.why: Purpura is a symptom rather than a diagnosis and does not account for the full spectrum of the patient's presentation.

rejected.label: vasculitis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of inflammation of the blood vessels, which is a hallmark of vasculitis, and the biopsy findings are more consistent with amyloid deposition.

rejected.label: renal failure
rejected.why: While the patient has renal impairment, it is one aspect of a broader clinical picture that is more comprehensively explained by AL amyloidosis.
